one_line: Early 7th‑century ruler of Thanesar who raised the Vardhana line to regional prominence in post‑Gupta north India.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his early 40s, medium‑tall and solidly built, with a commander’s posture and a seasoned warrior’s presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium‑brown north Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing the chin; thick eyebrows and intense almond eyes, default expression a calm, assessing gaze that hardens to resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered back into a low, tidy top‑knot at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothed; a narrow gold circlet with a small central oval gem (deep red) rests just above the forehead, holding the hair in place.
appearance.costume: Era‑appropriate post‑Gupta northern royal attire: a long‑sleeved, knee‑length cotton tunic (angarkha style) in muted deep red, crossing left over right and tied with hidden ties; over this, a sleeveless fitted outer vest in warm cream with subtle woven floral patterns along the edges; a broad, soft cotton sash in dark indigo wrapped firmly around the waist with its ends falling at the left hip; lower garment is a finely pleated dhoti in off‑white, wrapped to mid‑calf and neatly banded, allowing ease of riding; sturdy brown leather‑look sandals with ankle straps; jewellery limited to a simple gold torque‑style necklace, a pair of small rounded gold earrings, and a single plain gold armlet on the right upper arm; over his left shoulder drapes a light woollen shawl in pale beige with a thin red border and faint geometric patterning, worn like a commander’s cloak but kept practical and close to the body.
appearance.signature: A straight double‑edged iron sword of early medieval north Indian type with a slightly flared tip, simple crossguard and disc pommel, sheathed in a dark leather scabbard with brass fittings and suspended from a brown belt crossing his left hip; he often rests his right hand lightly on the hilt, signalling readiness without flamboyance.

ref_desc: Prabhakaravardhana is a medium‑tall, early‑40s north Indian king with an oval medium‑brown face, moustache and short beard, black hair in a low top‑knot held by a gold circlet, wearing a deep‑red angarkha, cream patterned vest, off‑white dhoti, indigo waist sash, beige shawl, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a plain‑hilted straight iron sword in a dark scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Prabhakaravardhana as a dignified post‑Gupta north Indian ruler: a medium‑tall, early‑40s man with a strong oval face, medium‑brown complexion, straight nose, thick brows, intense almond eyes, a neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, and thick black hair pulled into a low top‑knot at the back of the crown, held by a narrow gold circlet with a single deep‑red oval gem at the center. Show him in a long‑sleeved, knee‑length deep‑red cotton tunic crossing left over right (angarkha style), with a sleeveless fitted cream outer vest over it, the vest edges decorated with subtle woven floral borders. Wrap a broad dark‑indigo sash tightly around his waist, its ends hanging at his left hip, and give him an off‑white, finely pleated dhoti wrapped to mid‑calf, with crisp folds suitable for riding. Put sturdy brown leather‑look sandals with ankle straps on his feet. Drape a light pale‑beige woollen shawl with a thin red border and faint geometric pattern over his left shoulder and around his back like a commander’s cloak, but keep it close to the body, not billowing. Add restrained jewellery: a simple gold torque‑style necklace, small rounded gold earrings, and one plain gold armlet on his right upper arm. At his left hip, show a straight double‑edged iron sword with a simple crossguard and disc pommel in a dark leather scabbard with brass fittings, suspended from a brown belt, with his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette of deep red, cream, indigo, off‑white, beige, brown and gold, and present him in neutral, well‑lit poses from front and back to emphasize consistent face, hair, costume details and sword design.
